name: Wrist prep
description: Warms and loads the wrists and forearms before push-ups, handstands or any hand balancing. Fine to do before every session.

items.cue: Spread the fingers and keep the heels of the hands down.
Shift side to side, palms flat.
Fingers point back, sit back only to a mild stretch.
Hold still and breathe, palms flat.
Light pressure on the backs of the hands.
Fingers grip the floor, lift the palms with control.
Elbow straight, pull the fingers back gently.
Elbow straight, keep the stretch mild.
Turn the palms up and down, arms long.
